reasonDefinitions.accepted_exact_branch: One exact office identity passes all release checks.
reasonDefinitions.unresolved_source_wrap: The supplied body or city continuation is incomplete or wrapped. No boundary is guessed.
reasonDefinitions.uncertain_source_text: The source name contains an unresolved question mark.
reasonDefinitions.wrong_population: An explicit pediatric, children, or kids identity is outside this adult eldercare release.
reasonDefinitions.ambiguous_colocation: Distinct organization identities share this complete office address. No branch is released from that address.
reasonDefinitions.ambiguous_roster_identity: More than one distinct registered organization passes the identity checks.
reasonDefinitions.office_discrepancy: An exact legal or registered DBA name exists, but full street including unit, city, ZIP, or phone differs. This includes possible old or moved offices, not a confirmed move.
reasonDefinitions.organization_discrepancy: A location or phone anchor exists, but no specific legal or registered DBA name matches.
reasonDefinitions.not_in_published_roster: No exact organization, full office address, or phone anchor exists in the full published roster.
reasonDefinitions.roster_location_hold: The supplied bridge has an unresolved location hold.
reasonDefinitions.bridge_identity_conflict: The bridge does not agree with the published full office identity and independently retained registration identity.
reasonDefinitions.not_branch_office: Explicit headquarters-only, service-area-only, or non-office identity cannot support a branch release.
reasonDefinitions.not_found_in_supplied_counties: No exact identity anchor was found in the supplied nine-county PCA extract. This is not a nonparticipation finding.
reasonDefinitions.source_or_quality_exclusion: Anchored source rows exist but are excluded by source parsing, population, location, or ambiguity checks.
